name_en: Low-fi wireframe and ADHD-friendly visual organizers
what: إنتاج مخططات ASCII ومنظمات Mermaid مبسطة. — Produce ASCII or sketch wireframes and simple Mermaid organizers for focus.
when: User wants screen wireframe, whiteboard sketch or task breakdown visual.
how: 1. Default to ASCII wireframe; hand-drawn HTML on request. 2. Keep few nodes, color-code, chunk steps. 3. Mermaid for timelines, flows, checklists. 4. Iterate sketch until recognized.

name_en: Color system with accessibility and dark mode
what: تصميم تدرجات ألوان للعلامة والحياد والحالات تحقق التباين في الوضعين الفاتح والداكن. — Design brand, neutral and status colour ramps that meet contrast needs in light and dark modes.
when: Choosing a palette, status semantics, dark-mode, colour-blind support.
how: 1) Pick brand primary and a neutral ramp. 2) Define success/warning/error semantics with icon or text backup. 3) Check pairs against 4.5:1 text and 3:1 UI. 4) Re-derive dark mode rather than inverting. 5) Test with colour-blind simulation.

when: Before shipping components, i18n or RTL checks.
how: 1) List variable content slots. 2) Test extremes: long, empty, huge, multi-line. 3) Define truncation/wrap rules. 4) Provide image fallbacks. 5) Verify RTL and expanded translations.

what: تطبيق المحاذاة والشبكات والتقارب والتشابه لتنظيم التخطيط. — Apply alignment, grid systems, proximity and similarity so layouts read as organized groups.
when: Layout review, form field grouping, picking columns/gutters/breakpoints.
how: 1) Align every element to shared edges. 2) Choose columns, gutters, breakpoints and a baseline grid. 3) Group by proximity: gap between groups larger than within. 4) Use similarity for same-function items. 5) Keep labels close to their fields.

what: تدقيق واجهة من حيث التسلسل والمسافات واللون والعمق وتقييمها بقائمة فحص. — Audit a UI for hierarchy, spacing, color and depth and score it with a yes/no checklist.
when: UI looks amateur, spacing/colour inconsistency, component styling review.
how: 1) Judge hierarchy in grayscale/blurred first. 2) Limit emphasis levers (size, weight, colour) to one or two per element. 3) Use spacing scale 4/8/16/24/32/48/64 with group gaps larger than inner gaps. 4) Cap text width at 45-75 chars. 5) Score = round(passed/8*10) from 8 checks. 6) Add colour and shadows last.

what: إزالة الزخرفة الزائدة وتوزيع التأكيد بحيث يكسب كل عنصر مكانه. — Remove or densify decoration and budget emphasis so each cue earns its place.
when: Cluttered or sterile screens, deciding what to delete.
how: 1) List each decorative element. 2) Ask what information it carries; delete if none. 3) If too sparse, densify. 4) Allocate emphasis (colour, weight, size, motion) sparingly. 5) Re-check hierarchy.

name_en: Typography and legibility rules for web
what: اختيار الخطوط والأحجام والمقاييس وطول السطر لمقروئية أفضل. — Choose typefaces, sizes, scales and line lengths for legible web typography.
when: Setting type scale, readability complaints, font pairing.
how: 1) Pick a modular type scale. 2) Body size at least 16px, line-height about 1.5. 3) Line length 45-75 characters. 4) Limit to 1-2 families and few weights. 5) Establish typographic hierarchy via size/weight contrast.
